marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 knots increasing to northwest 25 early Friday
morning then diminishing to west 15 Friday afternoon. Scattered flurries changing to snow overnight then to
scattered flurries Friday evening. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
precipitation. Temperatures near zero. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 Friday morning then
subsiding to 1 or less Friday afternoon.<br/>
